verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's Wally Cloud exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint so standard OpenAI clients (which many coding agents use) can point base_url at it, and docs explicitly reference an 'opencode' coding-agent integration with a --cloud flag to select hosted vs local models. This shows real backend-connection capability, but the evidence is thin on setup depth and has no independent/hands-on confirmation of a coding agent actually running against it as a backend. Missing for 10: detailed agent-specific integration docs beyond a single flag mention, and community/hands-on verification of a coding agent successfully using it as a backend.
